summary.text: Andrew Hattaway is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 56B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent John Huot (D).

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Andrew Hattaway said his campaign is focused on practical problem-solving, transparency and steady community engagement.
He said he is passionate about policy that supports community safety, responsible and transparent budgeting, and core services such as schools, housing and emergency response.
